verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِهَارُونَ: «أَنْتَ وَبَنُوكَ وَبَيْتُ أَبِيكَ مَعَكَ تَحْمِلُونَ ذَنْبَ ٱلْمَقْدِسِ، وَأَنْتَ وَبَنُوكَ مَعَكَ تَحْمِلُونَ ذَنْبَ كَهَنُوتِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father’s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
verses.web: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן אַתָּ֗ה וּבָנֶ֤יךָ וּבֵית־אָבִ֙יךָ֙ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־עֲוֹ֣ן הַמִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־עֲוֹ֥ן כְּהֻנַּתְכֶֽם׃

verses.ar: وَأَيْضًا إِخْوَتُكَ سِبْطُ لَاوِي، سِبْطُ أَبِيكَ، قَرِّبْهُمْ مَعَكَ فَيَقْتَرِنُوا بِكَ وَيُوازِرُوكَ، وَأَنْتَ وَبَنُوكَ قُدَّامَ خَيْمَةِ ٱلشَّهَادَةِ،
verses.kjv: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee [shall minister] before the tabernacle of witness.
verses.web: Bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony.
verses.he: וְגַ֣ם אֶת־אַחֶיךָ֩ מַטֵּ֨ה לֵוִ֜י שֵׁ֤בֶט אָבִ֙יךָ֙ הַקְרֵ֣ב אִתָּ֔ךְ וְיִלָּו֥וּ עָלֶ֖יךָ וִֽישָׁרְת֑וּךָ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל הָעֵדֻֽת׃

verses.ar: فَيَحْفَظُونَ حِرَاسَتَكَ وَحِرَاسَةَ ٱلْخَيْمَةِ كُلِّهَا. وَلَكِنْ إِلَى أَمْتِعَةِ ٱلْقُدْسِ وَإِلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ لَا يَقْتَرِبُونَ، لِئَلَّا يَمُوتُوا هُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ جَمِيعًا.
verses.kjv: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
verses.web: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.
verses.he: וְשָֽׁמְרוּ֙ מִֽשְׁמַרְתְּךָ֔ וּמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת כָּל־הָאֹ֑הֶל אַךְ֩ אֶל־כְּלֵ֨י הַקֹּ֤דֶשׁ וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֔בוּ וְלֹֽא־יָמֻ֥תוּ גַם־הֵ֖ם גַּם־אַתֶּֽם׃

verses.ar: يَقْتَرِنُونَ بِكَ وَيَحْفَظُونَ حِرَاسَةَ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ مَعَ كُلِّ خِدْمَةِ ٱلْخَيْمَةِ. وَٱلْأَجْنَبِيُّ لَا يَقْتَرِبْ إِلَيْكُمْ.
verses.kjv: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
verses.web: They shall be joined to you and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent. A stranger shall not come near to you.
verses.he: וְנִלְו֣וּ עָלֶ֔יךָ וְשָֽׁמְר֗וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֔ד לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל וְזָ֖ר לֹא־יִקְרַ֥ב אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

verses.ar: بَلْ تَحْفَظُونَ أَنْتُمْ حِرَاسَةَ ٱلْقُدْسِ وَحِرَاسَةَ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ، لِكَيْ لَا يَكُونَ أَيْضًا سَخَطٌ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
verses.web: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.
verses.he: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֵ֖ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה עֹ֛וד קֶ֖צֶף עַל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

verses.ar: هَأَنَذَا قَدْ أَخَذْتُ إِخْوَتَكُمُ ٱللَّاوِيِّينَ مِنْ بَيْنِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَطِيَّةً لَكُمْ مُعْطَيْنَ لِلرَّبِّ، لِيَخْدِمُوا خِدْمَةَ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ.
verses.kjv: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you [they are] given [as] a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.web: Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to Yahweh, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.he: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנֵּ֤ה לָקַ֙חְתִּי֙ אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתֹּ֖וךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָכֶ֞ם מַתָּנָ֤ה נְתֻנִים֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا أَنْتَ وَبَنُوكَ مَعَكَ فَتَحْفَظُونَ كَهَنُوتَكُمْ مَعَ مَا لِلْمَذْبَحِ وَمَا هُوَ دَاخِلَ ٱلْحِجَابِ، وَتَخْدِمُونَ خِدْمَةً. عَطِيَّةً أَعْطَيْتُ كَهَنُوتَكُمْ. وَٱلْأَجْنَبِيُّ ٱلَّذِي يَقْتَرِبُ يُقْتَلُ».
verses.kjv: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest’s office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest’s office [unto you] as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.web: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
verses.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִ֠תְּךָ תִּשְׁמְר֨וּ אֶת־כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֜ם לְכָל־דְּבַ֧ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וּלְמִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹ֖כֶת וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֑ם עֲבֹדַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת־כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֔ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃ ס

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِهَارُونَ: «وَهَأَنَذَا قَدْ أَعْطَيْتُكَ حِرَاسَةَ رَفَائِعِي، مَعَ جَمِيعِ أَقْدَاسِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ لَكَ أَعْطَيْتُهَا، حَقَّ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ وَلِبَنِيكَ فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.
verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן֒ וַאֲנִי֙ הִנֵּ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֔ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת תְּרוּמֹתָ֑י לְכָל־קָדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לְךָ֙ נְתַתִּ֧ים לְמָשְׁחָ֛ה וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ לְחָק־עֹולָֽם׃

verses.ar: هَذَا يَكُونُ لَكَ مِنْ قُدْسِ ٱلْأَقْدَاسِ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ، كُلُّ قَرَابِينِهِمْ مَعَ كُلِّ تَقْدِمَاتِهِمْ وَكُلِّ ذَبَائِحِ خَطَايَاهُمْ وَكُلِّ ذَبَائِحِ آثَامِهِمْ ٱلَّتِي يَرُدُّونَهَا لِي. قُدْسُ أَقْدَاسٍ هِيَ لَكَ وَلِبَنِيكَ.
verses.kjv: This shall be thine of the most holy things, [reserved] from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, [shall be] most holy for thee and for thy sons.
verses.web: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall give to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.
verses.he: זֶֽה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ מִקֹּ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים מִן־הָאֵ֑שׁ כָּל־קָ֠רְבָּנָם לְֽכָל־מִנְחָתָ֞ם וּלְכָל־חַטָּאתָ֗ם וּלְכָל־אֲשָׁמָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָשִׁ֣יבוּ לִ֔י קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים לְךָ֛ ה֖וּא וּלְבָנֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: فِي قُدْسِ ٱلْأَقْدَاسِ تَأْكُلُهَا. كُلُّ ذَكَرٍ يَأْكُلُهَا. قُدْسًا تَكُونُ لَكَ.
verses.kjv: In the most holy [place] shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
verses.web: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.
verses.he: בְּקֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים תֹּאכֲלֶ֑נּוּ כָּל־זָכָר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל אֹתֹ֔ו קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּֽךְ׃

verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ لَكَ: ٱلرَّفِيعَةُ مِنْ عَطَايَاهُمْ مَعَ كُلِّ تَرْدِيدَاتِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ. لَكَ أَعْطَيْتُهَا وَلِبَنِيكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ مَعَكَ فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً. كُلُّ طَاهِرٍ فِي بَيْتِكَ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا.
verses.kjv: And this [is] thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
verses.web: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.
verses.he: וְזֶה־לְּךָ֞ תְּרוּמַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ם לְכָל־תְּנוּפֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְךָ֣ נְתַתִּ֗ים וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ לְחָק־עֹולָ֑ם כָּל־טָהֹ֥ור בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכַ֥ל אֹתֹֽו׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ دَسَمِ ٱلزَّيْتِ وَكُلُّ دَسَمِ ٱلْمِسْطَارِ وَٱلْحِنْطَةِ، أَبْكَارُهُنَّ ٱلَّتِي يُعْطُونَهَا لِلرَّبِّ، لَكَ أَعْطَيْتُهَا.
verses.kjv: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.
verses.web: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh.
verses.he: כֹּ֚ל חֵ֣לֶב יִצְהָ֔ר וְכָל־חֵ֖לֶב תִּירֹ֣ושׁ וְדָגָ֑ן רֵאשִׁיתָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־יִתְּנ֥וּ לַֽיהוָ֖ה לְךָ֥ נְתַתִּֽים׃

verses.ar: أَبْكَارُ كُلِّ مَا فِي أَرْضِهِمِ ٱلَّتِي يُقَدِّمُونَهَا لِلرَّبِّ لَكَ تَكُونُ. كُلُّ طَاهِرٍ فِي بَيْتِكَ يَأْكُلُهَا.
verses.kjv: [And] whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat [of] it.
verses.web: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.
verses.he: בִּכּוּרֵ֞י כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּאַרְצָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־יָבִ֥יאוּ לַיהוָ֖ה לְךָ֣ יִהְיֶ֑ה כָּל־טָהֹ֥ור בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכֲלֶֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ مُحَرَّمٍ فِي إِسْرَائِيلَ يَكُونُ لَكَ.
verses.kjv: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
verses.web: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.
verses.he: כָּל־חֵ֥רֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ فَاتِحِ رَحِمٍ مِنْ كُلِّ جَسَدٍ يُقَدِّمُونَهُ لِلرَّبِّ، مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَهَائِمِ، يَكُونُ لَكَ. غَيْرَ أَنَّكَ تَقْبَلُ فِدَاءَ بِكْرِ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ. وَبِكْرُ ٱلْبَهِيمَةِ ٱلنَّجِسَةِ تَقْبَلُ فِدَاءَهُ.
verses.kjv: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD, [whether it be] of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
verses.web: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.
verses.he: כָּל־פֶּ֣טֶר רֶ֠חֶם לְֽכָל־בָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֧יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֛ה בָּאָדָ֥ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֑ךְ אַ֣ךְ ׀ פָּדֹ֣ה תִפְדֶּ֗ה אֵ֚ת בְּכֹ֣ור הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְאֵ֛ת בְּכֹֽור־הַבְּהֵמָ֥ה הַטְּמֵאָ֖ה תִּפְדֶּֽה׃

verses.ar: وَفِدَاؤُهُ مِنِ ٱبْنِ شَهْرٍ تَقْبَلُهُ حَسَبَ تَقْوِيمِكَ فِضَّةً، خَمْسَةَ شَوَاقِلَ عَلَى شَاقِلِ ٱلْقُدْسِ. هُوَ عِشْرُونَ جِيرَةً.
verses.kjv: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which [is] twenty gerahs.
verses.web: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs.
verses.he: וּפְדוּיָו֙ מִבֶּן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה בְּעֶ֨רְכְּךָ֔ כֶּ֛סֶף חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

verses.ar: لَكِنْ بِكْرُ ٱلْبَقَرِ أَوْ بِكْرُ ٱلضَّأْنِ أَوْ بِكْرُ ٱلْمَعْزِ لَا تَقْبَلْ فِدَاءَهُ. إِنَّهُ قُدْسٌ. بَلْ تَرُشُّ دَمَهُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ، وَتُوقِدُ شَحْمَهُ وَقُودًا رَائِحَةَ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they [are] holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat [for] an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.web: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
verses.he: אַ֣ךְ בְּֽכֹור־שֹׁ֡ור אֹֽו־בְכֹ֨ור כֶּ֜שֶׂב אֹֽו־בְכֹ֥ור עֵ֛ז לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑ם אֶת־דָּמָ֞ם תִּזְרֹ֤ק עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ וְאֶת־חֶלְבָּ֣ם תַּקְטִ֔יר אִשֶּׁ֛ה לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: وَلَحْمُهُ يَكُونُ لَكَ، كَصَدْرِ ٱلتَّرْدِيدِ وَٱلسَّاقِ ٱلْيُمْنَى يَكُونُ لَكَ.
verses.kjv: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
verses.web: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.
verses.he: וּבְשָׂרָ֖ם יִהְיֶה־לָּ֑ךְ כַּחֲזֵ֧ה הַתְּנוּפָ֛ה וּכְשֹׁ֥וק הַיָּמִ֖ין לְךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה׃

verses.ar: جَمِيعُ رَفَائِعِ ٱلْأَقْدَاسِ ٱلَّتِي يَرْفَعُهَا بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ لِلرَّبِّ أَعْطَيْتُهَا لَكَ وَلِبَنِيكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ مَعَكَ حَقًّا دَهْرِيًّا. مِيثَاقَ مِلْحٍ دَهْرِيًّا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ لَكَ وَلِزَرْعِكَ مَعَكَ».
verses.kjv: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it [is] a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
verses.web: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your offspring with you.”
verses.he: כֹּ֣ל ׀ תְּרוּמֹ֣ת הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֥ימוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לַֽיהוָה֒ נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֗ וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ לְחָק־עֹולָ֑ם בְּרִית֩ מֶ֨לַח עֹולָ֥ם הִוא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְךָ֖ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אִתָּֽךְ׃

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِهَارُونَ: «لَا تَنَالُ نَصِيبًا فِي أَرْضِهِمْ، وَلَا يَكُونُ لَكَ قِسْمٌ فِي وَسَطِهِمْ. أَنَا قِسْمُكَ وَنَصِيبُكَ فِي وَسَطِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I [am] thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.
verses.web: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.
verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן בְּאַרְצָם֙ לֹ֣א תִנְחָ֔ל וְחֵ֕לֶק לֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ בְּתֹוכָ֑ם אֲנִ֤י חֶלְקְךָ֙ וְנַחֲלָ֣תְךָ֔ בְּתֹ֖וךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ ס

verses.ar: «وَأَمَّا بَنُو لَاوِي، فَإِنِّي قَدْ أَعْطَيْتُهُمْ كُلَّ عُشْرٍ فِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِيرَاثًا عِوَضَ خِدْمَتَهِمْ ٱلَّتِي يَخْدِمُونَهَا، خِدْمَةِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ.
verses.kjv: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, [even] the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.web: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.he: וְלִבְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הִנֵּ֥ה נָתַ֛תִּי כָּל־מֽ͏ַעֲשֵׂ֥ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְנַחֲלָ֑ה חֵ֤לֶף עֲבֹֽדָתָם֙ אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֣ם עֹֽבְדִ֔ים אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃

verses.ar: فَلَا يَقْتَرِبُ أَيْضًا بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ إِلَى خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ لِيَحْمِلُوا خَطِيَّةً لِلْمَوْتِ،
verses.kjv: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
verses.web: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.
verses.he: וְלֹא־יִקְרְב֥וּ עֹ֛וד בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֑ד לָשֵׂ֥את חֵ֖טְא לָמֽוּת׃

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱللَّاوِيُّونَ يَخْدِمُونَ خِدْمَةَ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ، وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ ذَنْبَهُمْ فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ. وَفِي وَسَطِ إِسْرَائِيلَ لَا يَنَالُونَ نَصِيبًا.
verses.kjv: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: [it shall be] a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.
verses.web: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.
verses.he: וְעָבַ֨ד הַלֵּוִ֜י ה֗וּא אֶת־עֲבֹדַת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֔ד וְהֵ֖ם יִשְׂא֣וּ עֲוֹנָ֑ם חֻקַּ֤ת עֹולָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּבְתֹוךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה׃

verses.ar: إِنَّ عُشُورَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ ٱلَّتِي يَرْفَعُونَهَا لِلرَّبِّ رَفِيعَةً قَدْ أَعْطَيْتُهَا لِلَّاوِيِّينَ نَصِيبًا. لِذَلِكَ قُلْتُ لَهُمْ: فِي وَسَطِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ لَا يَنَالُونَ نَصِيبًا».
verses.kjv: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer [as] an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
verses.web: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to Yahweh, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”
verses.he: כִּ֞י אֶת־מַעְשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֤ימוּ לֽ͏ַיהוָה֙ תְּרוּמָ֔ה נָתַ֥תִּי לַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה עַל־כֵּן֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי לָהֶ֔ם בְּתֹוךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה׃ פ

verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

verses.ar: «وَٱللَّاوِيُّونَ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ وَتَقُولُ لَهُمْ: مَتَى أَخَذْتُمْ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ ٱلْعُشْرَ ٱلَّذِي أَعْطَيْتُكُمْ إِيَّاهُ مِنْ عِنْدِهِمْ نَصِيبًا لَكُمْ، تَرْفَعُونَ مِنْهُ رَفِيعَةَ ٱلرَّبِّ: عُشْرًا مِنَ ٱلْعُشْرِ،
verses.kjv: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, [even] a tenth [part] of the tithe.
verses.web: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for Yahweh, a tithe of the tithe.
verses.he: וְאֶל־הַלְוִיִּ֣ם תְּדַבֵּר֮ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶם֒ כִּֽי־תִ֠קְחוּ מֵאֵ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תִּי לָכֶ֛ם מֵאִתָּ֖ם בְּנַחֲלַתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲרֵמֹתֶ֤ם מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ר מִן־הַֽמַּעֲשֵֽׂר׃

verses.ar: فَيُحْسَبُ لَكُمْ. إِنَّهُ رَفِيعَتُكُمْ كَٱلْحِنْطَةِ مِنَ ٱلْبَيْدَرِ، وَكَالْمِلْءِ مِنَ ٱلْمِعْصَرَةِ.
verses.kjv: And [this] your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though [it were] the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
verses.web: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.
verses.he: וְנֶחְשַׁ֥ב לָכֶ֖ם תְּרוּמַתְכֶ֑ם כַּדָּגָן֙ מִן־הַגֹּ֔רֶן וְכַֽמְלֵאָ֖ה מִן־הַיָּֽקֶב׃

verses.ar: فَهَكَذَا تَرْفَعُونَ أَنْتُمْ أَيْضًا رَفِيعَةَ ٱلرَّبِّ مِنْ جَمِيعِ عُشُورِكُمُ ٱلَّتِي تَأْخُذُونَ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ. تُعْطُونَ مِنْهَا رَفِيعَةَ ٱلرَّبِّ لِهَارُونَ ٱلْكَاهِنِ.
verses.kjv: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD’s heave offering to Aaron the priest.
verses.web: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to Yahweh of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give Yahweh’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.
verses.he: כֵּ֣ן תָּרִ֤ימוּ גַם־אַתֶּם֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִכֹּל֙ מַעְשְׂרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקְח֔וּ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּנְתַתֶּ֤ם מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

verses.ar: مِنْ جَمِيعِ عَطَايَاكُمْ تَرْفَعُونَ كُلَّ رَفِيعَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ مِنَ ٱلْكُلِّ، دَسَمَهُ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَ مِنْهُ.
verses.kjv: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, [even] the hallowed part thereof out of it.
verses.web: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to Yahweh, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’
verses.he: מִכֹּל֙ מַתְּנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תָּרִ֕ימוּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מִכָּל־חֶלְבֹּ֔ו אֶֽת־מִקְדְּשֹׁ֖ו מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: وَتَقُولُ لَهُمْ: حِينَ تَرْفَعُونَ دَسَمَهُ مِنْهُ يُحْسَبُ لِلَّاوِيِّينَ كَمَحْصُولِ ٱلْبَيْدَرِ وَكَمَحْصُولِ ٱلْمِعْصَرَةِ.
verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
verses.web: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.
verses.he: וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶ֤ם אֶת־חֶלְבֹּו֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְנֶחְשַׁב֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם כִּתְבוּאַ֥ת גֹּ֖רֶן וְכִתְבוּאַ֥ת יָֽקֶב׃

verses.ar: وَتَأْكُلُونَهُ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ أَنْتُمْ وَبُيُوتُكُمْ، لِأَنَّهُ أُجْرَةٌ لَكُمْ عِوَضَ خِدْمَتِكُمْ فِي خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ.
verses.kjv: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it [is] your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.web: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.he: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹתֹו֙ בְּכָל־מָקֹ֔ום אַתֶּ֖ם וּבֵֽיתְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־שָׂכָ֥ר הוּא֙ לָכֶ֔ם חֵ֥לֶף עֲבֹֽדַתְכֶ֖ם בְּאֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃

verses.ar: وَلَا تَتَحَمَّلُونَ بِسَبَبِهِ خَطِيَّةً إِذَا رَفَعْتُمْ دَسَمَهُ مِنْهُ. وَأَمَّا أَقْدَاسُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَلَا تُدَنِّسُوهَا لِئَلَّا تَمُوتُوا».
verses.kjv: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
verses.web: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”
verses.he: וְלֹֽא־תִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָיו֙ חֵ֔טְא בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶ֥ם אֶת־חֶלְבֹּ֖ו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְאֶת־קָדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לֹ֥א תְחַלְּל֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תָמֽוּתוּ׃ פ
